listing.name: Baldur's Gate II (original) (GemRB)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Official GemRB SourceForge desktop archives, Flatpak, or documented source build; provide original supported Infinity Engine installation and configure GamePath or positional game directory. Enhanced Edition support kept separate. Limits: Original supported games completable upstream; Planescape less polished, no multiplayer. Enhanced Edition support is separately experimental/unsupported. Upstream platforms: Official SourceForge Windows/Linux/macOS downloads and Flatpak. README documents Linux x86/x86-64/PPC/MIPS historical/source targets; selected artifact CPU is unknown until chosen. Original data: Check exact per-game support and editions; last GitHub release has no assets, confirm official distribution routes. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
